brief:
Israeli settlers in black masks and coordinated formation burned olive trees and hurled rocks at Palestinians during a Friday attack on an annual harvest in a West Bank village, Al-Monitor reported. A journalist was injured in the assault. The attack targeted the villagers' olive harvest, a seasonal event central to Palestinian agricultural life and economy.

The incident reflects escalating settler violence in the occupied territory, where such attacks on Palestinian farmers and their crops have increased in frequency. Olive harvesting remains a vulnerable period for Palestinian communities, with settlers often using the season to target agricultural areas and disrupt the harvest.

title: Israeli settlers burn olive trees, wound journalist in West Bank raid
